checks.check: A natural chest minecart provides personal loot
Moving a minecart preserves its identity and remaining roll
Destroying a chest minecart permanently retires its reward
Hoppers cannot extract unclaimed natural loot or insert stored items
A chest reached first by a hopper still supplies its original personal loot
A full player inventory neither consumes nor drops personal loot
Even a player-placed chest carrying a loot table remains ordinary
The shared Bedrock profile can continue an earlier Java roll
A Bedrock-identified connection can take items through the native click path
Returning from Bedrock to Java retains both the debit and received items
Creative worlds never create personal loot or cross-world rewards
All extra scenarios finish without loot runtime failures
